meta.name: Cinder-Pewter Clockwork Wick
meta.description: A whimsical, disposable clockwork pickaxe forged by the Ember Vendor using a Hollow Crucible Broker's Bundle and Cinder Ore. Guided by the Lithic Choir's teachings and the bioluminescent spore cartography of The Living Atlas & Mycelial Sanctuary of the Enclave, this tool hums with magnetotropic folk-science. It continuously winds its internal springs using ambient cinder heat, letting it automine for hours. However, the fragile pewter frame inevitably degrades and shatters. Its incredibly efficient battery usage prolongs auto-mining time.
